title: Simulation 3D Probabilistic Radar Configuration
text: Configure probabilistic radar signatures in 3D simulation environment, {Radar cross sections (dBsm)} sets Radar cross sections; {Radar targets} sets the identifiers corresponding to radar targets and {Default radar cross section (dBsm)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Radar targets
params.values: Identifiers corresponding to radar targets [] (default) | positive integer | L -length vector of unique positive integers

params.name: Radar cross sections (dBsm)
params.values: Radar cross sections {} (default) | real-valued Q -by- P matrix | L -length cell array of real-valued Q 1 -by- P 1, …, Q L -by- P L matrices

params.name: Default radar cross section (dBsm)
params.values: Default radar cross section -20 (default) | real scalar
